webExplicitReview.note: The real web also created/signed the prescription and received a confirmed follow-up. The initial harness then wrongly expected SIGNED rather than the actual CONFIRMED enum; that assertion failed. Subsequent real API checks verify the persisted signed state/booking, and the continued browser completes the same visit. No response interception or SQL state override.
